characters.continuity: Mortal Kombat series (Mortal Kombat 1992 through Mortal Kombat 11 and related media and comics)
characters.summary: Liu Kang is a legendary Shaolin martial artist and multi-time champion of the Mortal Kombat tournament. He relies on lightning-fast unarmed striking combinations, airborne kicks, and projectile fireballs, and possesses the magical ability to transform into a massive Chinese dragon. He is mortal in his standard form and vulnerable to coordinated magical and physical attacks, but his indomitable willpower and mastery of martial arts make him Earthrealm's premier defender.

Armed with supernatural ghost-hunting gear like the Poltergust series and a trusty flashlight, Luigi overcomes his fears to conquer paranormal and platforming threats alike.

He wields Psycho Power, a malevolent energy field that grants him superhuman strength, hovering flight, teleportation, and devastating momentum-based strikes like the Psycho Crusher. When his mortal vessel fails, he transfers his consciousness into clone bodies.
